Current-main validation inventory and implementation boundary are discovered and frozen with a kickoff-derived N and digest
Story change manifest and dual-revision impact graph cover additions, modifications, deletions, renames, scope, facts, capabilities, and conservative dynamic relations
Complete validation catalog and signed command input-closure certificates cover every inventory command with conservative whole-repository and never-reuse policy
Deterministic execute/reuse/unverified selection, full escalation, inventory accounting, monotonicity, and signed manifests are implemented without heuristic omission
DYN-1 observe-only validation preserves the complete plan as authority and isolates instrumentation and comparison evidence
DYN-2 source-first per-command receipts, canonical baselines, ancestry, expiry, clean-tree, build, and revocation admissibility are implemented
DYN-2 shadow reuse is compared against the complete-plan oracle with command and aggregate equivalence, failure-subset, and residue evidence
DYN-3 low-risk dynamic TEST authority is fail-closed on all Section 24 prerequisites and remains independent from focused and DONE-required authority
Dynamic validation operations, observability, rollback, mode controls, baseline audits, cache recovery, and honest risk-tier performance reports are delivered
Replay, FI-1 through FI-5, mutation, paired current-HEAD, false-negative, residue, and enforcement evidence blocks DYN-3 until thresholds pass
DYN-4 weighted LPT scheduling preserves capacity, exclusivity, drain barriers, command accounting, and serial-equivalent verdicts

Complete full-plan execution remains the fallback, periodic baseline, and audit oracle until dynamic authority is proven

No omission: complete inventory equals executed plus admissible reuse, with zero unverified, uncovered, and unmapped rows before authority
Rollback and staged observe/shadow/enforce controls preserve safe return to complete full execution
